products.name: Keldeo Box
products.note: Keldeo (Tinsel Holo) and a jumbo Keldeo-EX come with it, and the figure and no code card. Three packs, typically two Dragons Exalted and one Noble Victories (Bulbapedia only: this box came out a month before Boundaries Crossed). The jumbo card is not simulated.

products.name: Boundaries Crossed 3 Pack Blister [Empoleon]
products.note: Three packs, a Cosmos Holo Empoleon (BW56) and a Zoroark coin.

products.name: Boundaries Crossed 3 Pack Blister [Haxorus]
products.note: Three packs, a Cosmos Holo Haxorus (BW57) and a coin.

products.name: Boundaries Crossed Stage 1 Blister [Raichu line]
products.note: One pack and a Pikachu (BW54); the real blister also held a Cosmos Holo Raichu from Next Destinies and a Sampling Pack, which are not simulated.

products.name: Boundaries Crossed Stage 1 Blister [Beheeyem line]
products.note: One pack and an Elgyem (BW55); the real blister also held a Cosmos Holo Beheeyem from Next Destinies and a Sampling Pack, which are not simulated.
